scope: Read-only pointer hit-test of one visible project-level New chat action and the sidebar resize separator. No prompt was submitted, and the project action was not activated.
privacy: Project and task labels, account data, and screenshots are not retained. Only geometry, semantic role, and the hit-test result are recorded.
knownLimitations: This is one 1728×1001 dark-theme layout sample; compact widths, other themes, keyboard activation, and resizing while focused remain untested.
The record proves hit-target overlap and pointer interception, not installed-product pixel parity or a general failure across all projects.
